criteria.name: kernel.test.cjs passes including two-particle equilibrium and K=0 phase-invariance
criteria.evidence:
Ran `node src/sims/swarmalators/kernel.test.cjs`. All assertions pass:
- Metadata: name='Swarmalators', channelCount=2, channelLabels=['Density','Phase'], channelRanges=[[0,1],[0,1]], paramSchema keys match kernel
- Two-particle equilibrium: with particleCount=2, J=0, A=1, B=2, after 2000 steps at dt=0.01, final distance=2.0003 (within ±0.05 of theoretical d=B/A=2)
- K=0 phase invariance: with K=0, frequencySpread=0, phases unchanged after 100 steps (max diff < 1e-10)
- Grid output: state length = width*height*2, all values within channelRanges

Closed-form derivations independently re-verified:
- Two-particle: dx/dt = (A - B/d) * û, equilibrium at d=B/A=2 ✓
- K=0, ω=0: dθ/dt = 0 + 0 = 0, phases constant ✓

criteria.name: Browser smoke on /#/swarmalators renders legible particle swarm
criteria.evidence: Launched headless Chromium (Playwright) against local dev server (`npm run dev` on port 5173). Navigated to `http://localhost:5173/#/swarmalators`. Waited 3s for simulation to stabilise. Canvas renders visible multi-pixel particles (soft Gaussian splats, radius 3 cells) on a dark background. No blank or single-pixel field. Particles form a coherent disc/ring structure. FPS ~85. No console errors.

criteria.name: Each of five presets visibly matches its named state
criteria.evidence:
Browser smoke per preset (each run 5s, headless Chromium, screenshots captured):
- `static-sync` (J=1, K=1.5): Particles collapse to static disc, uniform colour (all same hue) — matches 'static disc, phases fully synchronised'
- `static-async` (J=-0.5, K=0): Static disc, phases locked to angular position forming frozen rainbow ring — matches 'static disc, each particle's phase locks to its angular position'
- `static-phase-wave` (J=0.5, K=0): Static annulus/ring, phase varies continuously around ring (colour wave, stationary) — matches 'static annulus/ring in which phase varies continuously'
- `splintered-phase-wave` (J=0.8, K=-0.3): Ring fragments into rotating/drifting clusters, each a shard of a phase wave — matches 'ring fragments into rotating or drifting clusters'
- `active-phase-wave` (J=1, K=-0.75): Whole formation keeps moving, phase wave rotates/drifts continuously — matches 'whole formation keeps moving; phase wave itself rotates or drifts continuously'

All five presets registered in `src/app/presets.ts` and selectable in UI.

criteria.name: Colour from reused cyclic phase ramp via twoChannelColour, no new ramp
criteria.evidence: Verified in `src/app/colormap.ts`: only change is a new `case "swarmalators":` in `defaultColourOptionsFor` (line 142) returning `{ ...base, preset: "phase", contrast: 1.1, gamma: 0.9 }`. Reuses existing cyclic `phase` preset ramp. No new ramp or preset function added. GLSL `twoChannelColour` in `src/app/shaders/fragment.glsl` (presets 11/12) has cyclic branch: `if (isCyclic) { float hue = c1; float brightness = c0; ... }` matching `colormap.ts` contract. Zero-density cells (c0=0) map to black.

additional_findings: Stage completed over 3 rounds. Round 1: kernel maths correct but rendering was 1px specks on mid-blue background. Round 2: splats added (soft Gaussian, radius 3) but background still mid-blue due to GLSL shader missing cyclic branch. Round 3 (verifier fix): added cyclic branch to GLSL `twoChannelColour` mirroring `colormap.ts` contract — zero density now maps to black. All six acceptance criteria now satisfied. Default particleCount=384, max=1200 justified by O(N²) real-time constraint (~85fps at 384, ~30fps at 1200 on M1).
